title.zh: 剂量与束流：送入多少不等于激活多少
title.en: Dose and beam current: delivered amount is not activated amount

subtitle.zh: 束流电流/扫描/电荷积分/剂量均匀性
subtitle.en: Beam current / scanning / charge integration / dose uniformity

body.zh: 稳定目标束流；调节源参数；获得稳定离子束
body.en: Stabilize the target beam Adjust source parameters to obtain a stable ion beam

body.zh: 测量束流电流；通过Faraday测量；实时束流电流
body.en: Measure beam current Use a Faraday device to measure beam current in real time

body.zh: 设定扫描轨迹；设定扫描速度与波形；实现均匀覆盖
body.en: Set the scan trajectory Set scan speed and waveform for uniform coverage

body.zh: 晶圆通过束流；离子束按轨迹；扫描整个晶圆
body.en: Pass the wafer through the beam The ion beam follows the trajectory across the entire wafer

body.zh: 电流随时间积分；电流；时间；对束流电流；进行时间积分
body.en: Integrate current over time Current Time Integrate beam current over time

body.zh: 送到目标剂量；完成注入；达到目标剂量
body.en: Deliver the target dose Complete implantation and reach the target dose

body.zh: 束流电流与密度；• 决定单位时间送入的离子数；• 影响剂量与注入均匀性
body.en: Beam current and density • Determines the number of ions delivered per unit time • Affects dose and implantation uniformity

body.zh: 剂量积分；电流；时间；• 电流-时间曲线的面积对应剂量；• 通过积分达到设定剂量
body.en: Dose integration Current Time • The area under the current-time curve corresponds to dose • Integrate to the specified dose

body.zh: 离子束扫描；Faraday；A
body.en: Ion-beam scanning Faraday A

body.zh: 扫描速度与波形；• 扫描速度决定单位面积停留时间；• 合适波形实现全片均匀
body.en: Scan speed and waveform • Scan speed determines dwell time per unit area • A suitable waveform yields wafer-wide uniformity

body.zh: Q = ∫ I(t) dt；注入剂量由束流电流的
body.en: Q = ∫ I(t) dt The implant dose is determined by beam-current

body.zh: Faraday与二次电子抑制；• 收集离子电流进行剂量测量
body.en: Faraday measurement and secondary-electron suppression • Collect ion current to measure dose

body.zh: 退火后只是一部分被激活并进入晶格。
body.en: Only some are activated and enter the lattice after annealing.

body.zh: 提高束流：产能提升 ↔ 温升、充电与量测难度增加；更高的束流可以缩短工艺时间，；但会带来晶圆温升、表面充电效应以及量测稳定性挑战。
body.en: Higher beam current: higher throughput ↔ more heating, charging and metrology difficulty Higher current can shorten processing time, but creates challenges in wafer heating, surface charging and measurement stability.

body.zh: 潜在风险：；欠剂量/过剂量；二次电子测量误差
body.en: Potential risks Underdose / overdose Secondary-electron measurement error

body.zh: 量测反馈：Faraday/ 束流积分/ 片阻图；过程量测；束流电流与电荷积分
body.en: Metrology feedback: Faraday / integrated beam current / sheet-resistance map In-process metrology Beam current and charge integration

body.zh: 退火后量测；片阻图评估电学效果
body.en: Post-anneal metrology Use sheet-resistance maps to assess electrical outcomes

body.zh: 片阻图；验证均匀性与工艺结果
body.en: Sheet-resistance map Validate uniformity and process outcomes

body.zh: 反馈调整；束流/扫描/积分
body.en: Feedback adjustment Beam / scan / integration

body.zh: 时间积分决定
body.en: time integration.

body.zh: 抑制二次电子避免测量偏差
body.en: Suppress secondary electrons to avoid measurement bias

body.zh: 核心提示：注入剂量 ≠ 退火后的活性浓度
body.en: Key point: implant dose ≠ active concentration after annealing

body.zh: 注入剂量是送入硅中的离子总数，
body.en: Implant dose is the total number of ions introduced into silicon,

body.zh: 扫描条纹
body.en: Scan stripes

body.zh: 中心—边缘偏差
body.en: Center-to-edge bias

body.zh: A
body.en: A

body.zh: e⁻
body.en: e⁻

body.zh: e⁻
body.en: e⁻

notes.zh: 原图写“电流—时间曲线的面积对应剂量”，并给出Q=∫I(t)dt；这里保留原述与公式，原图未给出面积或电荷态等换算条件。
notes.en: The source states that current-time area corresponds to dose and gives Q=∫I(t)dt. Both are preserved; the source does not specify area or charge-state conversion conditions.
